model.summary: Model favors PIT by 1.6 points (58% win chance). Biggest factors: Quarterback rating (PIT +2.3), Elo rating (PIT +1.8), Rest days (home minus away) (TB +0.6). The baseline of +1.9 covers typical home-field advantage.

total_model.summary: Model projects 43.8 total points (TB 21, PIT 23). Biggest factors: Wind x pass rate (lowers total 1.1), Combined quarterback ratings (raises total 0.9), Combined rushing offense EPA/play (raises total 0.7). The baseline of 45.7 is the typical NFL total in the training data.

qb_what_if.note: Approximate: swaps only the quarterback rating and the model's QB-change flag (a new starter counts as a change). Team offense and defense form stay as they are. A positive margin change favors the home team.
